properties.stimulation_pattern: Paired pre-post spike pairings (60-100 repetitions) at controlled intervals (Δt = -100 to +100 ms). Pre-leading-post (positive Δt) induces LTP; post-leading-pre (negative Δt) induces LTD. Frequency: 0.1-5 Hz typical.
properties.measured_effect: Bidirectional synaptic weight change: LTP for pre→post (Δt ~ +10 ms), LTD for post→pre (Δt ~ -20 ms). Magnitude: 20-60% change from baseline. Narrow LTP window (~20 ms), broader LTD window (~20-100 ms).
properties.key_paper: Bi & Poo (1998) J. Neurosci.; Markram et al. (1997) Nature; Sjöström et al. (2001) J. Neurosci.; Froemke & Dan (2002) Neuron
properties.gap_in_cloud: Most STDP protocols tested in vitro (acute slices). In vivo validation limited; cloud/cloud-adjacent systems lack real-time closed-loop STDP induction with millisecond precision. Gap: hardware-accelerated STDP delivery with online spike detection and adaptive timing.

properties.stimulation_pattern: Pre-post pairings at varying frequencies (1-50 Hz) with Poisson jitter. Test correlation between pairing frequency and plasticity direction (BCM curve replication). 75 pairings in 15 groups at fixed group spike rate.
properties.measured_effect: LTP at high frequencies (>20 Hz), LTD at low frequencies (<10 Hz). Transition frequency depends on cooperativity and depolarization. Rate-dependent modulation overrides timing at extremes.
properties.key_paper: Sjöström et al. (2001) J. Neurosci.; Pfister & Gerstner (2006) Neural Comp.; Shouval et al. (2002) PNAS
properties.gap_in_cloud: Requires real-time frequency tracking and adaptive pairing. Cloud systems lack deterministic sub-millisecond loop for frequency-dependent protocols.

properties.stimulation_pattern: EPSP paired with postsynaptic bursts (3-5 spikes at 150-300 Hz) instead of single spikes. Delay: +10 ms (EPSP→burst) typically. 60-70 pairings at 0.1-0.2 Hz.
properties.measured_effect: Burst-LTD: robust depression (40-60% of baseline), independent of spike order (pre→post or post→pre). Requires mGluR activation and T-type Ca2+ channels; NMDA-independent. Single-spike pairing at same delay yields LTP.
properties.key_paper: Körding et al. (2001) J. Neurosci.; Wang et al. (2005) J. Neurophysiol.; Nevian & Sakmann (2006) Neuron
properties.gap_in_cloud: Burst delivery requires precise multi-spike pattern generation. Cloud SDKs typically support single-pulse or simple burst patterns; complex burst-waveform shaping (intra-burst frequency, spike count) under-explored in available tools.

properties.stimulation_pattern: Three EPSPs paired with postsynaptic AP burst. Vary interval between last EPSP and burst. Induces bidirectional plasticity: LTP or LTD depending on timing and membrane potential.
properties.measured_effect: LTP predicted by depolarized Vm and high initial AP frequency. LTD facilitated by larger interval between last EPSP and preceding AP. Distinct mechanisms: LTP = NMDAR-dependent; LTD = mGluR/Ca2+ channel dependent.
properties.key_paper: Thomas et al. (1998) Nature; Wittenberg & Wang (2006) J. Neurosci.
properties.gap_in_cloud: Requires simultaneous control of pre-synaptic pattern (multi-spike EPSPs) and post-synaptic bursting with millisecond alignment. Not supported in current closed-loop SDKs.

properties.stimulation_pattern: MEA-evoked network bursts timed relative to STDP pairing (ΔT = -5000 to +5000 ms). STDP+ (LTP protocol): 50 Hz × 3 APs with EPSP 10 ms earlier. STDP- (LTD protocol): EPSP 10 ms later. Burst timing varied.
properties.measured_effect: Network burst 20 ms before STDP+ flips LTP→LTD. Burst 20 ms after STDP- flips LTD→LTP. Effect requires multi-synaptic input (not replicable by single EPSP+AP substitution). Independent of inhibition.
properties.key_paper: Morrison et al. (2007) Front. Cell. Neurosci.; Rodrigues et al. (2015) Front. Cell. Neurosci.
properties.gap_in_cloud: Requires MEA-wide network burst triggering synchronized with single-cell STDP protocols. Cloud systems lack multi-channel coordinated stimulation with μs precision across 64+ channels.

properties.stimulation_pattern: Real-time adaptive stimulation: error function minimized by iteratively updating stimulation patterns (stochastic search with annealing). Loop latency ~63 ms (CLNF) to <1 ms (on-hardware). Target: specific neural population response pattern.
properties.measured_effect: Error reduction 36-45% over 5-10 blocks. Selectivity index >0.5 for target vs. non-target populations. Drift-corrected learning across sessions.
properties.key_paper: Löwel & Singer (1992) - conceptual; more recent: Clopath et al. (2022) bioRxiv; Kording lab ACLS papers; eLife 2024 CLNF/CLMF (mesoscale Ca2+ feedback)
properties.gap_in_cloud: End-to-end latency critical. Cloud-based inference adds 10-100 ms round-trip; unsuitable for <5 ms plasticity windows. Need edge deployment (on-MEA or near-MEA) for true closed-loop plasticity.

properties.stimulation_pattern: Two-photon Ca2+ imaging → real-time decoding → closed-loop photo-stimulation to maintain target somatic Ca2+ level (optical clamp). Target: 1-5 SD above baseline. Duration: ~200 s.
properties.measured_effect: Behavioral-timescale synaptic plasticity (BTSP): evoked Ca2+ amplitude ↓18%, decay τ ↓37%. Intrinsic plasticity (IP) and synaptic scaling (SS) follow at slower timescales. Requires dendritic plateau potentials.
properties.key_paper: Bittner et al. (2017) Cell; Milstein et al. (2021) Neuron; recent all-optical BCI papers (2023-2024)
properties.gap_in_cloud: Requires 2P imaging + spatial light modulator + real-time decoding pipeline. Cloud integration only for offline analysis; closed-loop must run on local hardware.

properties.stimulation_pattern: STDP priming (post-before-pre, Δt = -20 ms) → 10 min delay → postsynaptic burst (5-6 APs @ 50 Hz) + dopamine application. Eligibility trace τ ~10 min.
properties.measured_effect: Priming sets NMDAR-dependent eligibility trace. Burst+DA converts LTD→LTP (135% of baseline). Requires postsynaptic NMDARs, PKA, and protein synthesis (anisomycin-sensitive).
properties.key_paper: Bittner et al. (2017) Cell; recent eLife/Nature Neuro papers on dopamine eligibility traces
properties.gap_in_cloud: Multi-modal: electrical STDP priming + delayed opto/chemogenetic burst + precise DA timing. Cloud orchestration possible for protocol sequencing but not for ms-precision burst delivery.

properties.core_idea: Sequentially selects experiments by optimizing an acquisition function (e.g., Expected Improvement, Upper Confidence Bound) derived from a surrogate model (often Gaussian Process) to balance exploration and exploitation.
properties.input_data: Previous experiment designs and outcomes, prior bounds on parameters, surrogate model hyperparameters.
properties.output_prediction: Next experiment design (parameter settings) and expected improvement or information gain.
properties.validation_method: Benchmark on synthetic functions (e.g., Branin, Hartmann), real-world scientific experiments (materials synthesis, drug discovery), ablation studies vs random search.
properties.gap_for_neural: Requires a differentiable simulator or likelihood; scalability challenges with high-dimensional neural data; limited incorporation of neural priors like biophysical constraints.

entities.name: Active Learning (AL) - Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD)

properties.core_idea: Selects data points (experiments) that maximize the reduction in model uncertainty (entropy) by measuring disagreement among posterior samples of model predictions.
properties.input_data: Labeled experimental data, unlabeled candidate experiments, ensemble of models or MC dropout to approximate posterior.
properties.output_prediction: Index of next experiment to label, expected information gain.
properties.validation_method: Comparison to random sampling and uncertainty sampling on benchmark datasets (e.g., UCI, image classification), real-world labeling cost reduction in neuroscience (e.g., electron microscopy).
properties.gap_for_neural: Assumes i.i.d. data; struggles with temporally correlated neural signals; acquisition functions often ignore experimental cost and temporal dependencies.

properties.core_idea: Learns a parametric policy network offline to map experimental history to next design, amortizing the cost of Bayesian optimal experimental design via contrastive information bounds.
properties.input_data: History of past designs and outcomes (sequence), prior over latent variables, simulator for generating synthetic trajectories.
properties.output_prediction: Next design (experiment condition) as a deterministic function of history.
properties.validation_method: Simulation studies on toy models (Gaussian linear, logistic regression), comparison to myopic BO and random policies in terms of expected information gain.
properties.gap_for_neural: Dependence on having a simulator to generate training trajectories; policy may not generalize to unseen neural experimental settings without retraining; limited interpretability for hypothesis generation.

properties.core_idea: Semi-amortized policy that periodically updates the design network as data accumulates, improving flexibility and robustness compared to fully amortized DAD.
properties.input_data: Accumulating experimental history, prior, base policy network.
properties.output_prediction: Next design; policy adapted online via fine-tuning or Bayesian updates.
properties.validation_method: Evaluation on sequential experimental design tasks (e.g., clinical trials, A/B testing), showing improved decision-making and robustness under distribution shift.
properties.gap_for_neural: Online update mechanism adds complexity; requires storage of history and retraining frequency tuning; still depends on simulator for pretraining.

properties.core_idea: Frames experimental design as a Markov decision process where an agent selects actions (experiments) to maximize cumulative reward (e.g., information gain, negative cost) through trial-and-error learning.
properties.input_data: State representation of past experiments and outcomes, action space of possible experiments, reward function (information gain, cost).
properties.output_prediction: Next action (experiment) to execute, learned policy.
properties.software_pkg: RLlib, Stable-Baselines3, Gym environments for experimental design (e.g., LabBench), custom simulators.
properties.validation_method: Simulation benchmarks comparing to BO and AL, real-world demonstrations in chemical synthesis and robotics.
properties.gap_for_neural: High sample inefficiency in real neural experiments; designing realistic reward functions for neural discovery is non-trivial; safety concerns in live neural tissue.
